label: ATEN SN0116CO 16-port serial console server (dual LAN/power)
description: 1U serial console server with 16 RJ45 RS-232 device ports (Cisco pin-out, auto-sensing DTE/DCE) and dual 10/100/1000BASE-T LAN ports so the production and management networks can be kept separate, or the second port used as failover; dual AC inputs. Console Management, Real COM, TCP/UDP Server-Client and Virtual Modem modes over Telnet/SSH or the HTML5 WebClient.
notes: Spec sheet: 'LAN Ports: 2 x RJ-45 Female' with '10/100/1000 Mbps' status LEDs for the SN01xxCO models, 'Serial: 16 x RJ-45 Female', plus 1 modem RJ45, 1 local-console RJ45, 1 Mini-USB Laptop USB Console port, 3 USB Type-A and one reserved 'PON' RJ45 - none of those extra RJ45s are Ethernet data ports, so only the two LAN ports are modelled. Security: TLS 1.2, FIPS 140-2 level 1 module, RADIUS/TACACS+/LDAP/Kerberos, 802.1X. Single-LAN/single-power siblings are SN9116CO.
